No front door

Followers stay followers

A surgeon or a VP can save your posts for a year and never give you an email address. Every month without a class is attention you earned and don't get to keep.

No qualifier

Your calendar does the filtering

An open strategy-call link means curious followers and ready clients land in the same slots. You find out who is serious only after you've given them the hour.

Capped by you

Growth runs on the next post

Your message is "get your time back", but new clients still depend on you showing up on Instagram. When you step away, the bookings step away too.

The high earners who love your content but aren't ready for a strategy call today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

My recommendation

A $17 Work Optional masterclass that pays for its own ads and fills your strategy calls

You have the credibility, the audience and a promise people want. What's missing is a low-cost first step. A paid 90-minute masterclass gives high earners a way to learn your framework for $17, offers a planner kit on the thank-you page, and invites the right people to apply for a strategy call on the replay page. Meta ads then put it in front of new high earners every day.

Fixes the missing front door

The masterclass becomes the link in your bio and the destination for your ads. Every buyer is an email you own and a person who has already paid you once.

Fixes the missing self-paced step

The Work Optional Planner Kit gives do-it-yourself high earners something useful to buy now, while they get used to your way of thinking.

Fixes the open calendar

Only people who watched the class and filled in a short application reach your calendar. Your strategy calls start with context, not from zero.

The 95%*

Not ready for coaching yet

They pay $17 for the class, many add the planner kit, and they keep learning from your emails. They fund the ads while they build trust in you.

The qualified 5%

Ready to make work optional

They stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters for fit before your calendar, and three pre-call emails warm them up for coaching.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The CFO question"

Hook
"When I was a CFO, the first question I asked about any business was this. Most high earners have never asked it about their own life." (to camera, warm light, white top as on your profile)
Body
"The question is: how long could we keep going if revenue stopped? For a household, that's your runway. Once you know it, and you know your Work Optional number, every money decision gets simpler." (on-screen captions: runway, your number)
CTA
"I walk you through both in a 90-minute masterclass called Work Optional. It's $17. Tap Sign up to grab your seat. Education only, not financial advice."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three numbers I'd track"

Hook
"If your household were my company, these are the only three numbers I'd look at." (Kaley holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: monthly cash flow, what's left after everything. Two: savings rate, as a percentage, not a dollar figure. Three: runway, how many months you could live without a paycheque. Most high earners only know their salary." (caption for each number)
CTA
"I show you how to work out all three in my Work Optional masterclass. $17, link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"You've made great money"

Hook
"You've made great money. Now you want your time back. If that's you, keep watching." (walking, natural light)
Body
"Most people I work with did everything right: the degree, the promotions, the income. What nobody gave them was a plan for when work becomes optional. That's the part I teach, using the same thinking I used as a CFO."
CTA
"It's a 90-minute masterclass called Work Optional, it's $17, and there's a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
